dt: Applications open Nov 2, 2026; full application due Jan 15, 2027, 11:59 pm EST (per program-details page)
e: Paid 10-week summer internships in science research, education and policy in the Washington, DC area, for undergraduate SPS members with at least two years of college physics. U.S. citizenship may be required for some positions, and all applicants must be eligible to work in the US without restriction.
unv: The program-details page also says applications are open Nov 2, 2026 - Jan 5, 2026 (apparently a typo), while giving the Jan 15, 2027 due date for the full application
